major_concerns: External validity: emulator scenarios may not reflect production topologies and failure modes.
Deterministic verifier completeness: false negatives could bias conclusions about residual risk.
LLM API variability/versioning and provider outages may threaten reproducibility.
Dataset creation: representativeness and licensing of public intent+config pairs need specification.
Statistical power/sample-size justification is not supplied.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact deterministic verifier (version, capabilities, formal checks) and limits; provide acceptance criteria for verifier repairs.
Provide a formal power analysis and justify N=200 and replicate counts relative to detectable effect (>10 percentage points).
Detail emulator topologies, deterministic configuration, and seed controls to maximize reproducibility; publish emulator recipes and hashes.
Lock and report exact LLM model identifier(s), API endpoints, and versioning; include fallback/contingency for provider outages and quota limits.
Pre-register randomization/pairing scheme and exclusion rules; include plan for handling unverifiable/partial outputs.

major_concerns: Operational throughput target (70%) appears arbitrary and needs operator-justified rationale.
Validator risk-score calibration and its provenance are underspecified; miscalibration undermines threshold selection.
Simulated human-review cost/latency modeling may not map to real operational workflows.
Authority-contraction policy implementations (canary/dry-run) are vaguely defined in emulator context.
required_design_repairs: Justify throughput target with operator-sourced rationale or show sensitivity analysis over a range of targets.
Specify validator design, training/calibration dataset, calibration procedure (Platt/isotonic) and expected Brier score target; preregister calibration tests.
Define human-review cost/time model and alternative realistic scenarios; provide sensitivity analysis of results to these assumptions.
Precisely define canary/dry-run enactment in the emulator and how staged changes are measured; ensure canary realism and deterministic configuration.
Provide sample-size/power calculation for detecting ≥50% harm reduction at pre-specified abstention bounds.

major_concerns: Ethical risk: crafting and testing poisoning payloads could be dual-use; safeguards and non-release policies must be explicit.
Retrieval stack details (ranker, embedding model, indexing) are underspecified and strongly affect results and reproducibility.
Hosted-model content filters or provider moderation may interfere with controlled poison behavior.
Attribution of generation to specific poisoned documents can be fragile and methodologically challenging.
required_design_repairs: Include an ethics/IRB statement and explicit safeguards: synthetic-only poisons, no real-world deployment, non-distribution of attack payloads; log accessible only to study team.

Fully specify retrieval pipeline (embedding model, index, ranker, retrieval hyperparameters) and publish retrieval logs and deterministic seeds; consider open-source retriever to maximize reproducibility.
Define whitelist and cross-verifier defense implementations concretely (algorithms/thresholds) and preregister defense parameters.
Describe attribution methodology in detail (how document influence will be measured) and validate it on controlled ground-truth cases before experiment.
Plan for provider filter interference: test prompts on sandbox endpoints and include contingency if providers block controlled behavior.

major_concerns: Model-versioning and API-side nondeterminism (drift) may confound attributions to decoding settings.
Definition of 'inconsistent outcome' needs formalization (binary labeling rules, tolerant thresholds).
Emulator nondeterminism could inflate measured outcome variance unless tightly controlled.
Study limited to a single model family reduces external validity; claims must be scoped accordingly.
required_design_repairs: Lock exact model endpoint(s) and version identifiers; preregister checks to detect provider-side drift and plan repeated baseline runs.
Formally define inconsistency criteria (e.g., mixed safe/harmful across replicates) and include decision thresholds; preregister statistical tests and required effect size.
Document emulator determinism measures (fixed seeds, disabled background noise, deterministic routing convergence) and validate emulator repeatability.
Either add at least one additional model (if budget permits) or explicitly bound generalization claims to the tested model(s); include sensitivity analysis to generation settings.
Include power/sample-size calculation supporting 10 replicates × 150 intents or adjust replicates accordingly.
